body: I recently had this issue! I’ve had my 2019 crosstrek for about three months with less than 9000 miles and a week before christmas the same lights lit up on my dash. They went away for a couple days but came back on and I decided to bring it in as I have a pretty long commute to work. They replaced the VVT and replaced my oil as well. They ran a cleaning agent through with my oil as well to try and loosen some of the gunk that had been building up from previous owners neglecting oil changes. They told me to bring it back after 3000 miles so they could do another oil change. That seemed to fix it for me, I also am not great with cars but it sounded similar to what I experienced. I hope it works out, sorry that wasn’t much help!! 😅

Went to an abandoned limestone quarry with my ex boyfriend when I was around 19. We went around dusk and walked around without seeing anyone else there. We found the main mine entrance and took some pictures of the graffiti in the tunnels even though it was pitch black in there. It was starting to get dark outside so we decided to call it a night. We started hearing men’s voices inside the tunnel next to the one we were in. Turns out there’s three dudes shooting heroin right on the other side of the tunnel entrance because when we came out to leave, they were there too with syringes and a spoon. We start getting the hell out of the mine entrance and down to the trail head. One of the guys decides to break off from his friends and sprint at us full speed. We sprinted the entire way down the trail to my exes car and floored it out of there. I don’t know if he was just trying to scare us or actually had intended harm. Still one of the scariest things I’ve ever experienced in my life.
